name: Codersly SEO
author: Codersly

sections.description:
If you are comparing the best SEO WordPress plugin options for a business site, blog or WooCommerce store, Codersly SEO gives you a complete free SEO core with practical controls for on-page optimization, technical SEO and structured data.

Codersly SEO is an advanced WordPress SEO plugin built around a clear Free + Pro model. Free includes the essential tools needed to optimize a WordPress site. Codersly SEO Pro adds automation, scale, advanced workflows and Bring Your Own API (BYOK) AI features without requiring Codersly-managed AI credits.

Why choose Codersly SEO?

Codersly SEO brings commonly needed WordPress SEO tools into one organized plugin: SEO titles and descriptions, focus-keyword analysis, SERP previews, canonical and robots controls, XML sitemaps, schema markup, redirects, 404 monitoring, image SEO, Local SEO and WooCommerce SEO.

For site owners evaluating the best SEO WordPress plugin for day-to-day optimization, the goal is simple: provide a strong free foundation while keeping advanced automation and AI optional in Pro.

Core features (free)

  • SEO title and meta description with live SERP preview.
  • One focus keyword and live SEO score/checks in the editor.
  • Canonical URL, Index/Noindex, Follow/Nofollow and advanced robots controls per content item.
  • Facebook/Open Graph and X/Twitter title, description and image overrides.
  • Per-page schema selection plus Organization/Person, WebSite, WebPage, Article, Product and Breadcrumb schema foundations.
  • XML sitemap index with post, page, product and taxonomy controls; Image, News and Video sitemap enhancements are Pro.
  • Virtual robots.txt controls and sitemap declaration. Pro adds one-click common AI-crawler allow/block control.
  • Attachment-page redirects.
  • 301, 302, 307 and 410 redirect manager.
  • Basic 404 monitor with URL, referrer, hits and last-seen data.
  • Breadcrumbs and structured BreadcrumbList data.
  • Basic single-business Local SEO information and structured-data foundations; opening hours and multi-location workflows are Pro.
  • WooCommerce product SEO and Product schema basics.
  • Missing-ALT reporting for images; automatic, bulk and AI ALT workflows are Pro.
  • Basic site SEO analysis/checks.
  • Setup wizard.
  • Optional llms.txt discovery file.
  • JSON settings backup/restore (license/API secrets excluded).
  • Import helpers for common SEO plugin metadata including Rank Math, Yoast and AIOSEO-compatible post meta.
  • Settings export/import from Tools → Export / Backup.

WordPress SEO workflow

Use Codersly SEO to manage the main SEO areas of a WordPress website from one admin section:

  1. Configure global Titles & Meta settings.
  2. Optimize individual posts, pages and products with the editor SEO panel.
  3. Review the focus keyword, SERP preview and on-page SEO checks.
  4. Configure XML Sitemap, Schema, missing-ALT reporting and basic Local SEO settings.
  5. Monitor 404 URLs and create redirects when needed.
  6. Use WooCommerce SEO controls for product-focused stores.

Codersly SEO Pro

The optional Codersly SEO Pro add-on extends the free WordPress SEO plugin with advanced schema workflows, global noindex automation, up to five focus keywords, deeper content analysis, internal-link suggestions, BYOK AI Content, BYOK AI Audit, advanced 404 workflows, wildcard/regex redirects, WooCommerce identifiers, automatic/bulk/AI image ALT tools, AI crawler control and Image/News/Video sitemap enhancements.

AI in Pro uses API keys owned by the site administrator. Codersly does not provide or meter AI credits.

Get Codersly SEO Pro:
https://codersly.com/codersly-seo-pro-pricing/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the codersly-seo folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install through WordPress Plugins.
  2. Activate Codersly SEO.
  3. Open Codersly SEO in the WordPress admin and use Dashboard → Setup.
  4. Configure Titles & Meta, Sitemap, Schema, Image SEO, Local SEO and other feature menus as needed.
  5. Edit a post, page or product to use the Codersly SEO editor panel.
sections.faq:
Is Codersly SEO a free WordPress SEO plugin?

Yes. The free version includes core metadata, focus-keyword analysis, sitemap, schema, social metadata, redirects, basic 404 monitoring, Local SEO foundations and per-content robots/canonical controls.

Is Codersly SEO suitable when comparing the best SEO WordPress plugin options?

Codersly SEO is designed as an advanced SEO plugin for WordPress with a strong free core and optional Pro automation. The right SEO plugin depends on your site’s requirements, so test the features that matter to your workflow.

Does it support WooCommerce SEO?

Yes. Free includes core product SEO and Product schema support. Pro adds advanced product identifiers, merchant data and automation workflows.

Does it support Local SEO?

Yes. Codersly SEO includes Local SEO foundations. Pro adds advanced and multi-location workflows.

Can I run another SEO plugin at the same time?

It is not recommended because duplicate titles, canonicals, schema and sitemaps can conflict.

Does the free plugin send site content to Codersly?

No AI service is required by the Free plugin. Pro AI is optional and BYOK-based, so the administrator connects a supported AI provider with their own API key.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Centralized sidebar active-state resolution for all Codersly SEO routes, including the top-level Dashboard route and extension-owned hidden pages.
  • Added a safe admin-menu fallback so sidebar selection remains correct when another admin-menu customization changes WordPress parent/submenu state.
  • Kept the Codersly SEO sidebar selected on hidden setup screens and reduced repeated setup notices to the Dashboard only.
  • Positioned Codersly SEO in a collision-safe preferred admin-menu slot after Pages without forcing the global WordPress menu order.
  • Rebuilt the admin navigation around feature-oriented sidebar menus with contextual tabs only where needed.
  • Improved Pro feature labels so PRO indicators appear on hover/focus instead of being permanently duplicated in tabs.
  • Repositioned Codersly SEO as a full advanced WordPress SEO plugin rather than a lightweight-only utility.
  • Added editor SERP preview, focus keyword, SEO score/checks, canonical, robots, social overrides and per-content schema controls.
  • Added basic 404 Monitor to Free.
  • Added 307 and 410 support to Redirect Manager.
  • Added sitemap content controls and attachment-page redirects.
  • Added setup wizard, basic site checks, SEO metadata importer, settings backup/restore and optional llms.txt.
  • Added modular sidebar visibility, Titles & Meta sections, dedicated Image/Local/WooCommerce SEO pages, Tools and Settings tabs.
  • Updated all Free-version Get Pro links to the Codersly SEO Pro pricing page so users can choose the appropriate plan.
  • Removed Pro implementation, license-gated premium handlers and premium option ownership from the Free package; Free now contains discovery placeholders and generic extension hooks only.
  • Moved premium Image/News/Video sitemap settings, automatic/bulk image ALT, Local SEO opening hours, AI crawler control, advanced redirect groups and automatic slug-redirect controls into the separate Pro add-on.
  • Refined readme positioning around the “best SEO WordPress plugin” search intent while keeping copy natural and feature-focused.
  • Hardened WordPress.org Plugin Check compliance: sanitization, nonce annotations, output escaping, prefixed template variables and query cleanup.
